title: MusicFlow v5.2.0
releaseNotes: Xbox Music look (Windows 8.1): black canvas, Xbox green, big lowercase titles, flat square tiles, panorama page header on the phone
Left pane with search, your playlists and the now-playing tile; pages are Collection, Radio, Explore, Browse, Search
Home shows a now-playing tile and a featured tile; the player bar is a Windows Phone app bar with circle buttons
Now Playing on wide screens: artwork and controls on the left, Up Next / Lyrics / Related on the right
No more flicker on Home; the 'More like...' shelf never shows empty tiles twice
The whole phone screen is used (same colour under the status bar and toolbar)
YouTube: a track is matched to the catalog only when title, version and artist or length agree, so it never plays a different song; honest message when YouTube allows only a preview
Audio quality: 320 kbps catalog streams confirmed; YouTube streams pick the best format the phone can play
signingNote: Versions 2.7.3 and older were signed with a different key: uninstall them before installing 5.0.0.

ios.note: Sideload only. On iPhone, open the site itself in Safari and Add to Home Screen.
